variants.name: Double hop
variants.desc: Two hops with squash and stretch, eyes squeezed with joy.

variants.name: Spin jump
variants.desc: Crouches, leaps into a full spin and lands in a puff of dust.

variants.name: Puff up
variants.desc: Swells up with pride while sparkles pop around it.

variants.name: Dance
variants.desc: Waddles side to side with rosy cheeks.

variants.name: Ta-da
variants.desc: Stretches tall, eyes wide, and fires off a burst of confetti.
